showcaseCardModalDescription: Generic modal whose container is any of the card variants above — freely combine variant, animation, and draggable.
showcaseCascadingNavDescription: Cascading navigation dropdown, opens downward or upward based on the direction prop.
showcaseDecoratedCardDescription: 8 ready-to-use decorative variants — no imposed size, content dictates size.
showcaseEntityDetailBrowserDescription: Entity + list of browsable sub-items, detail panel and related-entity panel, all via props. Click the first lesson or the + button to see the trainer.
showcaseFieldsDescription: Single, multi-variant input field (outlined / filled / standard / kinetic).
showcaseFolderGalleryDescription: Generic interactive folder — 'items' accepts any React content. Two examples below: photos and profile cards.
showcaseGlassCardDescription: Standalone liquid glass effect (blur + distortion + highlights), used internally by Toast.
showcaseMenuDescription: Animated (GSAP) side navigation panel — configurable side: left or right.
showcaseSheetDescription: Draggable modal sheet, anchored top or bottom based on the side prop.
showcaseToastDescription: 'Liquid glass' notification, 3 variants: default (countdown), transfer (real progress), actions (customizable commands).
showcaseSelectDescription: Generic selection popover (compound component) — trigger + panel with search, avatar/initial fallback, fully customizable rendering.
showcaseImageSwiperDescription: Swipeable card stack (stacked 3D effect, Tinder-style) — swipe a card left or right to send it to the back of the stack.
showcaseCircularGalleryDescription: Circular-pill gallery (GSAP + MotionPathPlugin) — click a thumbnail to expand it full-frame, with a bounce on close. Autoplays every 4.5s.
showcaseTestimonialCardDescription: Swipeable testimonial stack (translucent glass) — swipe the front card left to send it to the back of the stack.
